defect.fact: Workspace close only called prepareClose for dirty/recovery state. An actual control-format edit could still await original Worker acknowledgement while accepted model was clean, so close disposed its client immediately. Original U2red/1readonlycontrolpass and r93 actual clean-range held reply/closed tab prove gap. Office close now always performs Office preparation; serialized operations counted from enqueue through finally, close drains all outstanding operations even when not started/clean, rejected current operation blocks with original saveError while preserving editing view; clean readonly can close without any save. Explicit discard remains deliberate. Only OfficeBuffer and WorkspaceStore production changes.

coverage.U: Three new real Store/FileBuffer queue cases: held accepted/rejected edit while model clean, no close before callback; accepted saves once/closes, rejected keeps client/view and explicit discard closes. Clean readonly zero writes. Final23buffer+30workspace+27preview and newU3 included. Early unit error assertion later refined from tab.error to original buffer.saveError so failure retains preview; first red occurred earlier at unchanged premature-close assertion.
coverage.I: Seven new actual WorkspaceStore/FileBuffer/FileService/r94Worker/native scenarios: pending checkpoint, append/edit and final save/materialize each success/failure, plus clean in-flight real format. Native error/output object delayed unchanged; checkpoint failure actual private recovery root permission guard, append invalid formula, materialize actual parent write denial. During gate no dispose, failures keep source exact original/client alive, explicit retry saves latest and target format. Public pauseAutosave isolates close queue (real App normalautosave separate). Final111 all selected0skip includes existing J09/session/J07/W27 and preview/store regressions. No calculation engine in I, actual cached fallback.
coverage.A: Normalr94, light/dark seven scenarios each14. Actual formula active MetaS or format Bold, hold one original successful/error callback, titlebarclose while waiting retains tab/client. Release success closes only after native saved; failure dialog preserves dirty current document, Continue View then faultclear/explicit refocused MetaS retry closes/reopens exactlatest. Clean format begins dirtyfalse; final bold via independent ZIP/XML and actual reopened format state. Independent reader preserves merges/columns/format/rawunrelatedparts, saved receipt matches exact sourcehash. Six failure branches never modify original source before explicit retry. All14close/reopen paths have exactlyonegenuine savedsnapshot beforefirstclose; second cleanclose noextra write.
coverage.proof: Independent originalV8outputs/errors digest+decode, all original auth frames/args hashes stable, held callback before clientclose, real savedrevision equals finaldisk, everytemporarymode restored. Original watch alwayspassive/unchanged; no replay/fake results/model/Store mutation. All retained threads exit, nine original handlers restore, zero rendererexception, finalnormal0/null. Allthree ownApp parentPIDs and userData/projecttokensgone; notclaim everytransientnativechildsampled.

Missingfocus step is verified driver deficiency; exact original key target not recorded, so no narrower rootcauseclaim. Productionpackage unchanged, no timeout relaxation.
